subtitle: The Transparent Item Resource Pack
description:
Do you feel like the items take up too much screen space? Well this is the pack for you!

This pack makes items and blocks semi transparent while you are holding them, so that you can see straight through whatever is in your hand!

It only applies in first person, meaning items stay solid in your inventory, on the ground, and in item frames.

This way they can stay regular size, but not obscure your vision.
